whatsNew.releaseNotes: Read the full release notes on GitHub

r1000.title: The workspace, rebuilt
r1000.summary: Version 1.0 turns metacodex into a focused command center for local projects, real terminals and the coding agents already in your toolchain.
r1000.workspaceBody: Projects and live sessions stay on the left, terminal work stays centered, and files, diffs and browser previews remain available on the right.
r1000.runtimeBody: Reliable PTY lifecycle, replay-safe events, attention states, session history and graceful shutdown keep long-running coding sessions under control.
r1000.browserBody: Preview local projects, inspect or capture a region, and send visual context directly to the active coding agent without leaving the workspace.
r1000.platformsBody: Native browser capture, external file opening and listener discovery now cover Linux and Windows from the same local-first codebase.

r1001.fixesBody: Codex resume uses the resume subcommand, history rows show the CLI instead of just the branch and can be discarded, and Linux terminals keep UTF-8 instead of inventing en_US.UTF-8.

r0019.title: A brighter place to start
r0019.launchBody: Opening a project now greets you with a centered launch stage: a command bar to start a terminal, your recent sessions, and one tap per AI agent.
r0019.kimiBody: Kimi Code joins the launcher, ready to run in a single click alongside the other agents.

r0018.title: A fresh face for metacodex
r0018.identityBody: New app icon, refreshed brand mark and a redrawn icon set across the whole app.
r0018.explorerBody: Every project is watched in the background, with a manual sync button and natural file sorting.
r0018.notesBody: This summary appears once after each update, with a link to the full notes on GitHub.

usage.title: Agent usage
usage.nearLimit: An agent is approaching its usage limit
usage.waitingReset: This window ended. Waiting for a fresh reading.
usage.description: Account limits and local activity, with a clear source for every number.
usage.localFirst: Metrics stay on this device. Prompts and responses are not stored.
usage.fetchError: Could not update usage. Previous readings remain visible with their observation time.
usage.linkError: Could not open the provider documentation.
usage.historyScope: Account-wide activity reported by Codex, in UTC. Missing days have no reported data. This is not a breakdown by project or a bill.
usage.noHistory: No account history reported for this period.
usage.localSessionsDescription: Running sessions on this device. Account quotas above can also include activity outside Metacodex.
usage.noSessions: No running sessions in this selection.
usage.estimatesDescription: Latest reported estimate for each observed execution. Values can restart on resume or /clear; they are not added together and do not represent subscription charges.
usage.noEstimates: Session estimates appear after the Claude integration receives activity.
usage.claudeSetupDescription: Enable the Metacodex status line for new Claude sessions launched here. It replaces the session’s existing status line while active. Your global Claude settings are not edited.
usage.claudeSetupLimits: Requires Claude Code 2.1.251+ and a supported plan for quotas. Existing sessions need to be reopened. Managed settings may prevent collection; launches with explicit --settings or --bare are left unchanged. Disabling stops new readings, including from existing sessions.

empty.partial: No quota data reported for this account.
empty.waiting: Waiting for the first usage reading.
empty.disabled: Enable the local integration to read usage.
empty.unsupported: No connected quota source. View details for available options.
empty.notInstalled: Install the CLI to connect usage.
empty.signedOut: Sign in through this agent’s CLI, then refresh.

source.codex-cli: Read from the installed Codex CLI and its current account. Quotas are shared across that account. API-key authentication may not expose subscription limits.
source.claude-code: Read from the latest observed session’s official status line. Claude does not identify the account in this payload, so quotas from different sessions are not combined.
source.cursor-cli: Account quotas and history come from Cursor’s authenticated dashboard. The optional CLI hook records local turns separately.
source.grok: Reads billing from the Grok Build CLI. A connected account file also enables authenticated billing and quota requests. xAI API billing is separate.

usage.cursorSetupDescription: Collect tokens reported by new Cursor CLI sessions launched in Metacodex. Uses your existing Cursor sign-in. A local plugin is added only to these launches; your global settings and hooks stay in place.
usage.cursorSetupLimits: Update Cursor CLI before enabling, then reopen existing sessions. Shows up to 500 observed turns over 90 days. Disabling stops new readings from running sessions too.
usage.cursorTurnsDescription: Token counters reported by the CLI for each observed turn, grouped by project. Cache counters are shown separately. These readings do not include the Cursor editor, other devices, earlier turns, monthly allowance or subscription charges.
usage.noTurns: Turn metrics appear after an enabled Cursor session completes a response.
usage.localQuotaUnavailable: Local activity available. Connect your personal account in Usage details to read its allowance.
usage.grokBillingNote: Dates are reported by the connected Grok account. A billing renewal is separate from a usage reset. Missing quota or consumption is not treated as zero.
usage.grokNoQuota: Personal plan connected. Grok did not report the included allowance or consumption.
usage.cursorSetupEnabled: Collection enabled. New sessions use your current Cursor sign-in. Reopen any sessions started before enabling.
usage.cursorAccountDescription: Connect the Cursor editor session by selecting state.vscdb. The picker opens its account folder. If you only use the CLI, you can connect a cursor.com session cookie instead.
usage.grokAccountDescription: Connect your existing Grok login by selecting auth.json from the Grok folder. This reads your personal plan, billing period and any quota reported by Grok.
usage.fileConnected: Local account file connected. Sign in again in the provider app if the session expires.
usage.cookieConnected: Browser session connected for this Metacodex run. Closing the app forgets the cookie.
usage.cookieHelp: In cursor.com browser developer tools, open Application or Storage, then Cookies. Copy only the value of WorkosCursorSessionToken. It stays in memory until you disconnect or close Metacodex.
usage.accountPrivacy: Credentials are sent only to the selected provider. Local account files are read without changing them. Account usage is separate from project activity.
usage.accountHistoryNote: Includes activity reported across your Cursor account. Charged amounts are plan deductions; API equivalent is a reference cost. These events cannot be attributed to a local project. Dates use UTC.
usage.accountHistoryIncomplete: The complete history could not be retrieved. Partial totals are hidden. Refresh to try again.
usage.accountHistoryEmpty: No events reported for this period.
usage.accountBillingNote: A billing renewal is separate from a usage reset. Unreported consumption remains unavailable.
usage.accountNoQuota: The account did not report a quota percentage.

accountIssue.signedOut: Session expired or not authorized. Sign in again in the provider app or reconnect the browser session.
accountIssue.invalidCredential: The selected file does not contain a usable account credential.
accountIssue.ambiguousAccount: Multiple Grok accounts were found. Select the intended account in the Grok CLI before reconnecting.
accountIssue.personalOnly: This credential belongs to a team. Connect a personal Grok login.
accountIssue.noQuota: The provider did not expose the quota. Billing dates may still be available.
accountIssue.rateLimited: The provider rate limited this request. Wait before refreshing.
accountIssue.unavailable: Account usage could not be updated. Any previous reading is marked as stale.
accountIssue.protocol: The provider returned an unrecognized usage format.
accountIssue.timeout: The provider did not respond in time. Refresh to try again.
